summary: OP Bancorp filed an 8-K to report its preliminary unaudited financial results for Q1 2026, disclose an investor presentation, and announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.14 per share payable on May 21, 2026 to holders of record on May 7, 2026. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or structural change is involved. The filing is a routine earnings and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No advisor, premium, or deal mechanics are applicable.
